description: Open, edit, run, and debug the workspace of a tOS (Raspberry Pi 5) board from VS Code on your PC. No VS Code Server is installed on the board.
capabilities.untrusted: The remote terminal and debug configuration are applied only in trusted workspaces.
config.title: tOS Remote
config.host: Board IP address or host name
config.remoteWorkspace: Workspace path on the board (created if it does not exist)
config.driveLetter: Drive letter to mount the workspace on (for example `Z:`). Leave empty to pick a free letter starting from Z:.
config.identityFile: SSH private key path. If empty, `~/.ssh/id_ed25519`, `id_ecdsa`, and `id_rsa` are tried in order, and `~/.ssh/id_ed25519` is created when registering a key.
config.pythonCommand: Python command used to run scripts on the board
config.pythonLibraryPaths: Python package paths on the board to copy locally for IntelliSense (Pylance). If empty, they are detected automatically (global site-packages, `~/.local`, and virtual environments in the workspace; SSH key required). Paths set here are all treated as required.
config.pathMappings: Additional remote → local path mappings for terminal links. `local` can use `${workspaceFolder}`.
config.rclonePath: Path to an rclone.exe you provide (for offline use). If empty, the extension downloads rclone once.
debugger.label: tOS Remote Python
debugger.program: Python file to run (${file} or a path in the remote workspace)
debugger.snippet.description: Run and debug the current Python file on tOS
task.file: File path relative to the remote workspace
walkthrough.title: Get Started with tOS Remote
walkthrough.description: Set up your PC to open the workspace of a tOS board.
walkthrough.winfsp.title: Install WinFsp
walkthrough.winfsp.description:
Required to connect the board workspace as a Windows drive. Install it once per PC; administrator approval (UAC) is required.
[Install WinFsp](command:tosRemote.installWinFsp)
walkthrough.rclone.title: Install rclone
walkthrough.rclone.description:
Downloads the latest rclone from the official site, verifies its SHA-256, and installs it in the extension storage. This is done only once.
[Install rclone](command:tosRemote.installRclone)
walkthrough.board.title: Enter Board Settings and Test the Connection
walkthrough.board.description:
Check the board host, user, and workspace path in the tOS Remote panel in the sidebar, then test the connection.
[Open Panel](command:tosRemote.panel.focus)
[Test Connection](command:tosRemote.testConnection)
walkthrough.sshKey.title: Register an SSH Key
walkthrough.sshKey.description:
Enter the board password once to register your PC's SSH public key. After that, the terminal, run, and debug work without a password.
[Register SSH Key](command:tosRemote.setupSshKey)
walkthrough.open.title: Open the Remote Workspace
walkthrough.open.description:
Connect the board workspace as a drive and open it in VS Code.
[Open Remote Workspace](command:tosRemote.openWorkspace)
